lines.text: Fair enough, let's try your idea.

example.text: Fair enough, let's try your idea.

misuse.text: Don't say 'fair enough' to a rude insult.
misuse.why: It sounds like you agree with them.

data.l1_hook: रुको, पहले मेरी वजह सुनो! "fair enough"
data.l1_ex: "fair enough", चलो तुम्हारा विचार आज़माते हैं।
